Trump Puts New AI Names to A Vote

on Saturday to argue that "artificial intelligence" is an "inaccurate, and very ineloquent" name for the technology.
He asked users to choose among "Superior Intelligence," "Extreme Intelligence" and "Supreme Intelligence."

In the initial polls, "Superior Intelligence" led on both platforms. On Truth Social, it had 41% of the vote, compared with 38% for "Extreme Intelligence" and 21% for "Supreme Intelligence," based on more than 64,000 votes.

Many people think that the words "Artificial Intelligence" are inaccurate, and very ineloquent, relative to AI, or Artificial Intelligence. A far more elegant and accurate description of this new phenomena would be Superior Intelligence (SI) or, Extreme Intelligence (EI) or,…
On X, "Superior Intelligence" had 41.4%, followed by "Supreme Intelligence" at 30.8% and "Extreme Intelligence" at 27.8%, with more than 226,000 votes.

children: Trump Proposes ‘AI Force’ And ‘AI Czar’
The naming poll came as Trump announced plans to establish an "AI Force" and appoint an "AI Czar" to monitor bad actors in the artificial intelligence industry.
Trump said the new force would be modeled after the Space Force and would seek out "BAD" activity through the existing criminal justice system.
The president said the initiative would not "hinder or stifle the Growth" of AI but instead "cherish it, help it, and watch over it, as it grows!"
